SYMPTOM: After full ingestion of Productive project sessions (including 560 voice recording transcripts), got 155 memories with ~15 unique concepts each duplicated 5-10 times. 'Qwen thinking mode disable trick' appeared 7 times. Global memories (personal/philosophical insights) never surfaced cross-project.

CAUSE 1 (duplication): Curator was completely blind to existing memories. Each curation call extracted independently with no knowledge of what was already stored. Cross-segment curation of long sessions meant same fact extracted in segment 1 and segment 2 independently.

CAUSE 2 (global routing): engine.ts storeCurationResult() routed ALL memories to store.storeMemory() (project scope) regardless of curator-set scope:'global'. Global memories physically landed in project folder, never served as globals.

CAUSE 3 (manager failure): LLM-based manager was supposed to deduplicate post-curation but was itself unreliable and didn't actually supersede.

FIX: All three addressed in fork at /Users/ned/Desktop/Projects/memory

PREVENT: Don't run `memory ingest --all` on the rlabs version again — it will duplicate further. Wait for fork to be deployed.
